'''Philippe Parise Mind What You Have Learned LS''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Philippe Parise]] posted on DeckTech. The published title is not used as the page title; it appears in the original post below.<ref name="dt-13541">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13541 DeckTech post 13541], DeckTech (Philippe "Climax_Giver" Parise, 10 February 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/13541/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/13541/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018053125/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13541/ Wayback Machine].</ref>
